feature_queries.name: time_calendar
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
       EXTRACT(year FROM e.timestamp) AS asof_year,
       EXTRACT(month FROM e.timestamp) AS asof_month,
       EXTRACT(day FROM e.timestamp) AS asof_day
FROM eval_table e

feature_queries.name: customer_static
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
       CASE WHEN c.customer_name IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_customer_name,
       LENGTH(COALESCE(c.customer_name,'')) AS customer_name_len
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN customer c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id

feature_queries.name: review_recency_counts
feature_queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_reviews_all_time,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_reviews_7d,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_reviews_30d,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_reviews_60d,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_reviews_90d,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_reviews_180d,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_reviews_365d,
         MAX(rv.review_time) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS last_review_time,
         MIN(rv.review_time) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS first_review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT customer_id, timestamp,
       n_reviews_all_time, n_reviews_7d, n_reviews_30d, n_reviews_60d, n_reviews_90d, n_reviews_180d, n_reviews_365d,
       CASE WHEN last_review_time IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', last_review_time, timestamp) END AS days_since_last_review,
       CASE WHEN first_review_time IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', first_review_time, timestamp) END AS days_since_first_review
FROM r

feature_queries.name: review_gaps_stats
feature_queries.sql:
WITH last_two AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    MAX(rv.review_time) AS last_t
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp
), prev AS (
  SELECT
    lt.customer_id,
    lt.timestamp,
    MAX(rv.review_time) AS prev_t
  FROM last_two lt
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.customer_id = lt.customer_id
   AND rv.review_time < lt.last_t
  GROUP BY lt.customer_id, lt.timestamp
)
SELECT
  lt.customer_id,
  lt.timestamp,
  CASE WHEN lt.last_t IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', lt.last_t, lt.timestamp) END AS gap_days_since_last,
  CASE WHEN lt.last_t IS NULL OR p.prev_t IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', p.prev_t, lt.last_t) END AS gap_days_prev_to_last
FROM last_two lt
LEFT JOIN prev p
  ON p.customer_id = lt.customer_id AND p.timestamp = lt.timestamp

feature_queries.name: review_velocity_trend
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp)
        -
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'))
         AS delta_reviews_last30_vs_prev30,
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp)
        -
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'))
         AS delta_reviews_last90_vs_prev90
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN review rv
  ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
 AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: active_days_spread
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, CAST(rv.review_time AS DATE) AS rday
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
)
SELECT customer_id, timestamp,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rday) FILTER (WHERE rday >= CAST(timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AS DATE) AND rday < CAST(timestamp AS DATE)) AS n_active_days_30d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rday) FILTER (WHERE rday >= CAST(timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AS DATE) AND rday < CAST(timestamp AS DATE)) AS n_active_days_90d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rday) FILTER (WHERE rday >= CAST(timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AS DATE) AND rday < CAST(timestamp AS DATE)) AS n_active_days_365d
FROM base
GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: review_rating_verified_filled
feature_queries.sql:
WITH s AS (
SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
       AVG(rv.rating) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS avg_rating_365d,
       STDDEV_SAMP(rv.rating) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS std_rating_365d,
       AVG(rv.rating) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS avg_rating_90d,
       AVG(rv.rating) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS avg_rating_prev90d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN rv.verified THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS frac_verified_365d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN rv.verified THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS frac_verified_90d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN rv.verified THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS frac_verified_prev90d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN review rv
  ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
 AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  customer_id, timestamp,
  avg_rating_365d, std_rating_365d,
  COALESCE(avg_rating_90d, avg_rating_365d) AS avg_rating_90d_filled,
  CASE WHEN avg_rating_90d IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_rating_90d,
  CASE WHEN avg_rating_prev90d IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_rating_prev90d,
  COALESCE(avg_rating_90d, avg_rating_365d, 0) - COALESCE(avg_rating_prev90d, avg_rating_365d, 0) AS delta_avg_rating_90d_filled,
  frac_verified_365d,
  COALESCE(frac_verified_90d, frac_verified_365d) AS frac_verified_90d_filled,
  CASE WHEN frac_verified_90d IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_verified_90d,
  CASE WHEN frac_verified_prev90d IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_verified_prev90d,
  COALESCE(frac_verified_90d, frac_verified_365d, 0) - COALESCE(frac_verified_prev90d, frac_verified_365d, 0) AS delta_frac_verified_90d_filled
FROM s

feature_queries.name: review_product_diversity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, rv.product_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
)
SELECT customer_id, timestamp,
       COUNT(product_id) AS n_reviews_365d_for_div,
       COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS n_distinct_products_365d,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(product_id)=0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT product_id)*1.0/COUNT(product_id) END AS product_diversity_ratio_365d
FROM base
GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: product_price_stats
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
       AVG(p.price) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS avg_price_reviewed_365d,
       MIN(p.price) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS min_price_reviewed_365d,
       MAX(p.price) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp) AS max_price_reviewed_365d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN review rv
  ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
 AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN product p
  ON p.product_id = rv.product_id
GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: brand_diversity_windows
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, rv.review_time, p.brand
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN product p
    ON p.product_id = rv.product_id
)
SELECT customer_id, timestamp,
       COUNT(DISTINCT brand) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND review_time < timestamp) AS n_distinct_brands_30d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT brand) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND review_time < timestamp) AS n_distinct_brands_90d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT brand) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND review_time < timestamp) AS n_distinct_brands_365d
FROM base
GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: category_diversity_windows
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, rv.review_time, p.category
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN product p
    ON p.product_id = rv.product_id
), exploded AS (
  SELECT customer_id, timestamp, review_time, UNNEST(category) AS cat
  FROM base
  WHERE category IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ex.cat) FILTER (WHERE ex.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ex.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_distinct_categories_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ex.cat) FILTER (WHERE ex.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ex.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_distinct_categories_90d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ex.cat) FILTER (WHERE ex.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND ex.review_time < e.timestamp) AS n_distinct_categories_365d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN exploded ex
  ON ex.customer_id = e.customer_id AND ex.timestamp = e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp
